# azure-functions-cookbook-python

> Practical recipes and examples for Azure Functions Python v2.

## Package Info

- Repository: https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-cookbook-python
- Version: 0.4.0 <!-- x-release-please-version -->
- Python: >=3.11, <3.15
- License: MIT
- Docs: https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/

## What It Provides

Content-first cookbook for Azure Functions Python v2 with curated pattern pages under `docs/patterns/`
and matching runnable example projects under `examples/`. This repository documents practical trigger
patterns and architecture decisions; it does not provide a runtime API library.

## Recipe Categories

Pattern pages live in `docs/patterns/<category>/<slug>.md`; the runnable app for each one lives in
`examples/<category>/<name>/`. 81 published recipes across 14 categories:

- APIs & Ingress (14): hello HTTP, routing/query/body, auth levels, EasyAuth claims, JWT validation,
  multi-tenant auth, GitHub webhook, APIM backend, BFF facade, full-stack CRUD, scaffold walkthrough,
  and three OpenAPI return-type inference pages
- Scheduled & Background (3): NCRONTAB timer job, scheduled queue dispatch, durable timer reminder
- Blob & File Triggers (4): polling upload processor, Event Grid blob trigger, CSV-to-table load,
  thumbnail generation
- Async APIs & Jobs (3): HTTP 202 + polling, callback completion, queue-backed job
- Messaging & Pub/Sub (9): Storage Queue producer/consumer, Service Bus worker, sessions, topic
  fan-out, DLQ replay, Event Grid router and domain events, claim-check
- Streams & Telemetry (3): Event Hub consumer, batch window, checkpoint replay
- Data & Pipelines (6): Cosmos DB change feed, CQRS read projection, DB input/output bindings,
  ETL enrichment, file-processing pipeline, SQLAlchemy REST pagination
- Orchestration & Workflows (11): durable chaining, fan-out/fan-in, entities, sub-orchestration,
  human interaction, singleton monitor, retry pattern, saga compensation, determinism gotchas,
  async job lifecycle, durable unit testing
- Reliability (5): retry and idempotency, poison-message handling, circuit breaker, rate limiting,
  outbox pattern
- Security & Tenancy (4): managed identity for Storage and Service Bus, secretless Key Vault,
  tenant isolation
- Runtime & Ops (7): modular blueprints, host.json tuning, concurrency tuning, cold-start mitigation,
  observability tracing, output binding vs SDK, doctor diagnostics endpoint
- Realtime (1): WebSocket proxy endpoint
- AI & Agents (10): Azure OpenAI direct chat, streaming responses, image generation, embedding and
  vector search, RAG knowledge API, durable AI pipeline, MCP server, and three LangGraph agents
  (chat, RAG, tool use)
- Guides (1): local run and direct invocation workflow

The machine-readable inventory of every recipe (slug, title, category, example_path, tags) is
`recipes.json`, regenerated with `python scripts/gen_recipe_index.py`.

## Trigger Patterns Covered

- HTTP
- Timer
- Queue
- Blob
- Event Grid
- Service Bus
- Event Hub
- Cosmos DB
- Durable Functions

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-cookbook-python.git
cd azure-functions-cookbook-python
make install
make check-all
```

## Ecosystem

Part of **Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit**:

| Package | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [azure-functions-openapi-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-openapi-python) | OpenAPI spec generation and Swagger UI |
| [azure-functions-validation-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python) | Request/response validation and serialization |
| [azure-functions-db-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-db-python) | Database bindings for SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Cosmos DB |
| [azure-functions-langgraph-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-langgraph-python) | LangGraph deployment adapter for Azure Functions |
| [azure-functions-scaffold-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-scaffold-python) | Project scaffolding CLI |
| [azure-functions-logging-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-logging-python) | Structured logging and observability |
| [azure-functions-doctor-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-doctor-python) | Pre-deploy diagnostic CLI |
| **azure-functions-cookbook-python** | Recipes and examples |
